en.t: The one I think of is only this person.

units.source_text: 他故意模仿孩子的笔迹，却颇饶佳趣。

en.t: He deliberately imitated a child's handwriting, yet it had a considerable charm.

units.source_text: 众侍女说：“这正好给姑娘当习字帖呢。”

en.t: The ladies-in-waiting said, "This will be just right as a copybook for the young lady's handwriting practice."

units.source_text: 少纳言乳母代为复信道：“辱承慰问，不胜感戴。

en.t: The nurse Shonagon wrote a reply on her behalf, saying, "I am deeply grateful to have received your kind inquiry after her health.

units.source_text: 师姑病势转重，今日安危难测，现已迁居山寺。

en.t: The nun's illness has grown more serious, and today her condition is uncertain; she has now moved to a mountain temple.

units.source_text: 眷顾之恩，恐只能于来世报答了！”

en.t: I fear that your gracious kindness can only be repaid in the next life!"

units.source_text: 源氏公子看了回信不胜惆怅。

en.t: Prince Genji read the reply and was overcome with melancholy.

units.source_text: 此时正值衰秋夕暮，源氏公子近来为了藤壶妃子之事，心绪缭乱。

en.t: It was just then an evening in late autumn, and Prince Genji had lately been deeply unsettled over matters concerning Lady Fujitsubo.

units.source_text: 紫儿与藤壶妃子有血统关系，因此他的谋求之心更加热切了。

en.t: Because Murasaki was related by blood to Lady Fujitsubo, his desire to obtain her grew still more ardent.

units.source_text: 他回想起老尼姑吟“薤露将消未忍消”那天傍晚的情况，觉得这紫儿很可怜爱。

en.t: He recalled that evening when the old nun had recited, "The garlic dew is about to vanish, yet cannot bear to vanish," and he felt that Murasaki was deeply pitiable and lovable.

units.source_text: 转念一想，求得之后，是否会令人失望，心中又感不安。

en.t: Then, thinking again, he wondered whether she might prove disappointing after he obtained her, and uneasiness rose in his heart once more.
